lci.text: Aclazotz began as a mortal of the Fourth People who, afraid of death, slaughtered his own people, killed the last god as it emerged and became the bat god, until Ojer Axonil and his champions tore out one of his eyes and dragged him back beyond the veil.
The New Phyrexian Invasion awakens him, and Vito, leading a Church of Dusk expedition, finds him chained with golden chains and frees him with blood sacrifices.
He bites Vito and transforms his followers into bat creatures, announces the end of the Fifth Age, and closes dark shards around Chimil, plunging the Core into darkness.

His minions are defeated by the Sun Empire and the Oltecs, and Aclazotz escapes in the hold of a Dusk Legion ship bound for Torrezon, planning to conquer it and to take the vampire Vona de Iedo at his right wing.
